t: There are authorized to be appropriated such sums as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act.

fable.w: This is a bare authorization of appropriations. It involves no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking, or right to sue involving any party outside the federal government. There is no tempting contrary reading; nothing in the text concerns outside parties participating in a federal decision.
fable.s: There are authorized to be appropriated such sums as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act.

opus.w: This section only authorizes appropriations to carry out the Act. It involves no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking, or right to sue, so no one outside the federal government takes part in any federal decision. The phrase "carry out the provisions of this Act" might seem to bring in the rest of the Act, but this section on its own creates no process for outside parties.

qwen_chat.w: This section is a standard authorization of appropriations clause. It provides funding authority but does not establish any mechanism for public participation, consultation with outside entities, or advisory committees. It contains no procedural requirements for decision-making involving non-federal parties.
qwen_chat.s: There are authorized to be appropriated such sums as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that "carrying out the provisions of this Act" implicitly involves participation if other parts of the Act require it. However, this specific section is merely an authorization of appropriations (funding). It does not itself mandate or describe any process of consultation, coordination, or involvement with outside parties. It is a standard boilerplate funding clause.
